title: Congress councillors stage fake note protest over Ludhiana sweeping project

tea.why: Congress councillors opposed a proposed mechanical sweeping project, calling its financial terms fake and exorbitant.
tea.want: Thorough scrutiny and rejection of the proposed mechanical sweeping project.
tea.changed: Oct 10: Congress councillors staged a symbolic protest with fake currency outside the Ludhiana Municipal Corporation meeting.

summary: Congress councillors staged a symbolic protest outside the Ludhiana Municipal Corporation meeting on Saturday, carrying sacks filled with counterfeit currency notes to oppose a proposed mechanical sweeping project. Congress councillor Gaurav Bhatti asserted that the project was as fake as the counterfeit notes, citing financial concerns and a lack of proper scrutiny. The Opposition also raised questions regarding the financial burden of the project and transparency over outsourced sanitation workers. The General House meeting was subsequently postponed due to the demise of an Aam Aadmi Party councillor, with the next meeting scheduled for Monday.
demands: Thorough scrutiny of the mechanical sweeping project
Greater transparency regarding outsourced sanitation worker deployment
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Congress councillors staged a symbolic protest outside the Ludhiana Municipal Corporation venue using counterfeit notes.
